## 更新内容 / Changes

会话管理现在也会扫描本机默认 `~/.codex`，所以工作目录位于其他项目文件夹的 Codex 对话也能按来源、项目、标题、ID 或正文搜索并打开。默认目录为只读来源；SQLite 展示数据库被跳过，避免读取时创建或改动 WAL / SHM 临时文件。默认目录不作为配置、复制、同步、删除、归档或可见性修复目标；同 ID 的已登记副本仍可按其自身来源管理。

Session management now scans the local default `~/.codex` home, making Codex conversations from other project folders searchable by source, project, title, ID or body text and available to open. The default home is read-only. SQLite display databases are skipped to prevent reads from creating or changing WAL / SHM sidecars. The home is excluded from configuration, copy, sync, deletion, archive and visibility-repair targets; registered copies with the same ID remain manageable through their own source.

本机默认来源可按文件标题索引及 rollout 内容查找；不会从 SQLite 读取附加标题、项目名称或分页活动索引。默认来源的重复 rollout 无法由客户端 SQLite 索引确认时，保留多文件核对保护。

The default source can use its JSONL title index and transcript contents for search. SQLite-provided titles, project names and paginated-active-rollout indexes are not read. Duplicate rollout files from the default source remain protected for manual review when the client SQLite index cannot identify the active segment.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI、macOS Claude Desktop 的独立实例和客户端内登录或 API / 第三方连接，以及 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 API Key、Bearer 和 Claude 订阅 OAuth 连接；客户端需单独安装。Anthropic Messages 网关可用于 Desktop API 与 CLI，额度查询使用供应商的计费接口，与模型协议独立。云模式和 npm 包装启动器仍未接入。

支持 macOS 默认 Codex 会话目录及已登记的 Codex 会话目录；默认 `~/.codex` 中的本地 rollouts 以只读方式扫描。

Codex desktop / CLI, independent Claude Desktop instances on macOS with sign-in inside the client or API / third-party connections, and the official native Claude Code CLI on macOS are supported. CLI connections use API Keys, Bearer tokens or Claude subscription OAuth; Anthropic Messages gateways can be used by Desktop API and CLI connections. Install clients separately. Provider models, protocols and tests are selected per key, and Anthropic usage checks use the provider billing integration independently of the model protocol. Cloud modes and npm wrapper launchers remain unintegrated.

The app supports the local default Codex session home and registered Codex session directories. Local rollouts from the default `~/.codex` home are scanned read-only.

## 验证来源 / Verification

完整来源提交与标签将标识本次源码，匹配的 GitHub Release 工作流运行与公开 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 将提供安装包来源。默认 Codex 来源用临时数据验证过滤、正文搜索、打开、Token 用量及源文件不变；另用冷数据库与活动 WAL / SHM 夹具确认只读扫描不触碰 SQLite。相关 Electron UI 烟测、全量 TypeScript 回归、Go 代理测试、打包依赖检查和公开仓库检查均已通过；GitHub Release 流水线将对最终来源执行 macOS arm64 打包验收。本次未执行真实账号登录或付费模型请求。

The exact source commit and tag identify this release; the matching GitHub Release workflow and public `SHA256SUMS.txt` identify the installers. Isolated default-Codex UI tests cover filtering, body search, opening, token usage and unchanged source files. Cold and live WAL / SHM database fixtures verify that read-only scanning leaves SQLite untouched. Related Electron UI tests, full TypeScript regression, Go proxy tests, packaging dependency checks and public repository checks passed. The GitHub Release workflow will package and verify the macOS arm64 installer from the final source. No real account sign-in or paid model request was performed for this change.
